chapter_title: Concerning the Seed Grain that shall be formed by the Elements, and also be destroyed by them
chapter_note: The chapter is dominated by a compact correspondential-cosmological teaching: growth/formation and destruction of a seed/grain by the (five) elements, extended into the Manichaean cosmology of Matter and shadow. The only clear late material is the hagiographic dialogue frame and one institutional graft naming “teachers” and “elect.”

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue attribution using "apostle" and "builder of the church" is compiling-community hagiographic frame; it is not part of the older cosmological exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: “This seed grain and this barley grain that you see shall be formed and [...] and beautified by the five elements. Now, the warmth and the cold nourish the seed grain and the entire tree. So, just as these things nourish it [...] it is destroyed [...] through [...] hunger.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, process-focused mapping (seed/grain ↔ five elements; warmth/cold ↔ nourishment/destruction). Both sides remain within the cosmological/natural system; no institutional address or contemporary referents.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way also Righteousness gathers the five to it.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the institutional/application continuation: “So, it shall be chosen by the teachers and the elect; and they gather it in and ornament it [...] and it is well established [...]. Now, just as they that shall enlighten [...]” This shifts from cosmos→cosmos mapping to cosmos→church roles (teachers/elect) and thus belongs to the later pastoral/institutional layer.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening clause continues the correspondential pattern (a cosmic agent ‘Righteousness’ drawing ‘the five’), but the paragraph quickly pivots to explicit ecclesial categories (“teachers,” “elect”), indicating an editorial application graft.

paragraphs.core_text: “In this way too, a lack and a shortfall shall occur from place to place through them; and they who have chosen it have gathered it in and beautified and attained it, while an affliction shall arise for it through those.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the cyclical mechanism (formation/selection followed by lack/affliction) without naming church offices or giving exhortation. The referents (“them/those”) read as internal causal agents within the elemental/mixture system.

paragraphs.core_text: “People also shall be caused to stumble on their account, through the energy of Matter that dwells in them. It has poured its shadow over them, just as it shall also pour its shadow over the elements and destroy the fruits of all the trees.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systemic cosmology: personified Matter as an active force with an ‘energy’ and ‘shadow’ acting on people and elements alike—still cosmos→cosmos (mixture mechanics), not an address, rule, or NT citation.
